source: research/wp_layer run_2026.py (frozen 0cc376d), TEAM arm, fitted on 2022-2025

definitions.L: logit of the engine's home WP, p clipped to [1e-4, 1-1e-4]
definitions.r: share of regulation outs still to be played, floored at one half-inning: max(1 - done/(6*sched), 3/(6*sched)), done = ((inning-1)*2 + bottom)*3 + outs
definitions.d_prev: home minus away run differential per game, previous regular season (0 for a team with no previous season; every 2022-2026 game had one)
definitions.d_cur: home minus away run differential per game this season on earlier dates, each team's mean times n/(n+K_TEAM); 0 before a team's first game
definitions.runs: a game's runs are the final score rebuilt from the play-by-play (layer_features.game_table)
